---
name: Research idea
about: Propose an idea or an experiment (negative results welcome)
title: "[IDEA] "
labels: research
assignees: ''
---

Please read [docs/STATUS.md](https://github.com/NICE-DEV226/ACIES/blob/main/docs/STATUS.md) first: it lists what is proven, what already failed and what is unknown.

**The question**
One sentence. What would we learn?

**Why you think it could help**
The hypothesis and the reasoning. Link papers or prior art if any.

**The baseline it must beat**
Fixed resolution and a tuned two-stage cascade, unless you argue otherwise.

**Data and runtime**
Model and version, dataset, hardware and runtime (PyTorch, ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, OpenVINO, ...), how costs are measured.

**Protocol**
How calibration, certification and test are kept disjoint. How uncertainty is reported.

**What would make you drop it**
The result that would convince you it does not work. A clear negative is a contribution.

**Are you willing to work on it?**
- [ ] Yes, I will run the experiment
- [ ] I can help but need guidance
- [ ] Just an idea for someone else
